fullContentHtml:
IB JIO-II/ Tech Final Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : MHA Intelligence Bureau IB has released the final result for the post of Junior Intelligence Officer Grade II Posts on the official website of IB. This recruitment was released for 394 posts. Applications for the IB JIO-II/ Tech Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 23 August 2025, to 14 September 2025. The tier I examination was held on 15 October 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their IB JIO-II/ Tech Final Result 2025 from the link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 23 August 2025
  • Last Date : 14 September 2025
  • Online Fee Payment Last Date : 14 September 2025
  • Offline Fee Payment Last Date : 16 September 2025
  • Exam Date : 15 October 2025
  • Exam City Details : 03 October 2025
  • Admit Card : 12 October 2025
  • Answer Key : 16 October 2025
  • Result : 01 January 2026
  • Final Result : 29 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 650/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 550/-
  • All Female Candidates : Rs. 550/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
